1. Average the color in a 1x1, 3x3 or 5x5 square around the click.
2. Measure the color distance of each pixel to it, in RGB, HSV or Lab on a 0 to 255 scale.
3. Select pixels whose distance is at most the tolerance: only connected ones, or all of them.
4. With anti-alias on, give each pixel the mean of its 3x3 neighborhood.
5. Feather, then combine with the current selection by the mode.
